context_length_exceeded: The request exceeds the model's context.
tools_unavailable: No allowed machine accepts tools for this model.
tools_unavailable_hint: Pick a model on this PC, or send X-Aiodos-Tools: optional.
local_only: This request can only run on this PC, which does not have this model.
local_only_hint: Install the model on this PC in AIODOS.
graph_not_api: Editor-format graph: the API format is required.
graph_not_api_hint: Export the graph in API format in ComfyUI.
graph_invalid_hint: Check the graph's links, nodes and outputs.
patch_invalid_hint: A patch replaces an existing value of the same type, never a link.
forbidden_value: Value refused (path, address or folder annotation).
forbidden_value_hint: Give a file with an @in: token, a model by its name.
forbidden_node_hint: Nodes that call an online service do not go through AIODOS.
input_missing_hint: Upload the input (PUT /aiodos/v1/inputs/{sha256}) and declare it in "inputs".
input_hash_mismatch: The received file's hash does not match.
input_hash_mismatch_hint: Compute the SHA-256 of the bytes sent.
key_revoked: This application's access was revoked in AIODOS.
key_revoked_hint: Reconnect the application, after the user clicks.
key_expired_hint: Reconnect the application, after the user clicks.
scope_denied: This application lacks this permission in AIODOS.
scope_denied_hint: Ask for this permission too (connect with it).
where_denied: Compute location refused: wider than this application's access.
where_denied_hint: Narrow X-Aiodos-Where, or ask for this circle in AIODOS.
apps_closed: AIODOS is not open to applications.
requests_closed: AIODOS does not accept new applications right now.
blocked_program: This program was blocked in AIODOS.
blocked_program_hint: Settings → Applications and other tools → Blocked programs.
other_account: AIODOS runs under another Windows account.
program_mismatch: This key is bound to another program.
origin_refused: Origin refused: the AIODOS gateway does not answer web pages.
origin_refused_hint: Call AIODOS from the application's process, not from a page.
model_not_found: Unknown model in the AIODOS circle.
model_not_found_hint: Install the model in AIODOS, or pick one from the list.
not_supported: Feature not available in this AIODOS version.
no_machine: No allowed machine has this model right now.
no_machine_hint: Retry later, or pick another model.
model_unavailable: No allowed machine has these models.
model_unavailable_hint: Install the missing models (detail.models), or widen the compute location.
model_ambiguous: Same model name in several folders.
model_ambiguous_hint: Declare the model in "models" with its folder.
graph_too_large_hint: 2 MB per graph, 8 MB and 64 graphs per job.
rate_limited: Too many requests from this application.
quota_exceeded_hint: Fetch or delete finished files and jobs.
busy: Too many concurrent requests from this application.
peer_failed: The chosen machine could not answer.
engine_unavailable: The engine is not ready yet.
approval_unavailable: AIODOS runs without a window: open it to authorize the application.
